description.narrative: The Global Environment Facility (GEF) is the largest and most experienced multilateral fund dedicated to addressing environmental threats and has a crucial role in serving multiple Multilateral Environment Agreements as catalyzing integrator. The GEF-8 Programming Directions set out an ambitious strategic and operational vision for the GEF-8 period, aiming to maximize the GEF’s impact through an emphasis on integration. This strategic focus is solidified by a widespread consensus that the environmental, biodiversity and climate challenges are tightly interlinked and that the associated risks are existential. Responding to these crises require scaled-up and interconnected interventions that are systemic in design and can address the core drivers of harmful economic and social practices and unsustainability. Integration has been central to the GEF’s mission and the fund makes a critical and distinctive contribution by increasingly investing in systemic transitions in GEF-8 that can lead to transformation of productive practices, value chains, and consumption patterns.
